nina: Quick question for builds: when we publish the SDK, our CJS consumers are dropping source maps. That makes debugging a mess for users requiring CJS. Any tips to preserve source maps across the ESM/CJS builds?

oliver: Yeah, we should emit both maps and ensure package.json `exports` points to the `.map` alongside the cjs file. Also keep inline source maps for the cjs build to avoid bundlers stripping them.

nina: Ok. Also, for the CJS build we have runtime fetch detection that uses `require('undici')` inside a try/catch. But during packers/bundlers it can get inlined. Maybe move that code to a separate file and mark it as `exports` non-enumerable so webpack doesn't statically analyze?\n
build-bot: Added CI lint rule `sdk:no-static-undici` to fail if undici require/import appears in files other than `runtime-detection.js`.
